market.summary: After yesterday's 1% rally, the open looks flat to slightly mixed: early GIFT Nifty readings ranged from -0.15% to +0.4%. Overnight cues are soft: US tech fell (Nasdaq about -1.4%) after Alphabet's revenue miss and Microsoft's outlook, and Japan's Nikkei is down almost 3% this morning. FIIs turned small net sellers yesterday while DIIs bought nearly Rs 1,900 Cr; oil and the rupee are steady.

points.text: GIFT Nifty at 23,034 (+0.42%) at 7:01 IST per one report; another had it -0.15% at 6:54 IST, so read it as roughly flat.
US close 29 Oct: Dow -0.25%, S&P 500 -0.30% at 7,720, Nasdaq -1.38%. Asia early: Nikkei -2.76%, Hang Seng -0.59%, Shanghai -0.82%.
Provisional flows 29 Oct: FIIs net sold Rs 943.60 Cr, DIIs net bought Rs 1,924.41 Cr (28 Oct: both buyers, FII +871.83 / DII +643.35 Cr).
Brent about $113.6 (flat), rupee 95.21 per dollar unchanged, US 10-year yield eased to 4.91%. The ECB held rates; US September inflation picked up.
Thursday: Sensex +905 (+1.24%) at 74,151, Nifty +238 (+1.05%) at 22,937; Realty and FMCG led.

market.watch: A soft Asia and US tech sell-off could cap the open; Reliance results today may set the tone for the index.
